steps.name: install-full-training-runner
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 45dda6d; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage7c/full_training_runner.py > tools/ml/train_climate_v6.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/train_climate_v6.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/train_climate_v6.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: validate-and-stage-training-report
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json, math
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('build/climate_v6_training_seed1847.json')
d = json.loads(p.read_text())
assert d['schema_version'] == 6
assert d['feature_count'] == 38
assert len(d['output_names']) == 6
assert d['dataset']['rows'] == 6240
assert d['training']['parameter_count'] == 2502
assert d['training']['winner'] in {c['spec']['name'] for c in d['training']['candidates']}
assert len(d['training']['candidates']) == 4
for c in d['training']['candidates']:
    for k in ('balanced_mae','mae','rmse','macro_f1'):
        assert math.isfinite(float(c['validation'][k]))
for k in ('balanced_mae','mae','rmse','macro_f1'):
    assert math.isfinite(float(d['training']['winner_test'][k]))
print('TRAINING_RESULT_VALIDATION=PASS')
PY
mkdir -p reports/ml; cp build/climate_v6_training_seed1847.json reports/ml/climate_v6_training_seed1847.json; .venv/bin/ruff check tools/ml/train_climate_v6.py; git diff --check; git status --short

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-training-report
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -- tools/ml/train_climate_v6.py reports/ml/climate_v6_training_seed1847.json; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/ml/train_climate_v6.py reports/ml/climate_v6_training_seed1847.json; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Run full climate v6 training comparison'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
